modelspec.diagram.DiagramView.title: DiagramView
modelspec.diagram.DiagramView.description: What a graph shows (DESIGN.md § 13.4). Model is the forward slice that reaches the model's prediction; Train is the whole training step (data, parameters, forward, loss, backward, optimizer update, checkpoint); Eval is the held-out evaluation, forward and loss with dropout the identity; Infer is what `modelspec infer` runs from a checkpoint, or one model function with `--function`.
